reasons: Deviation classification is correct: a one-month 'Fees actually paid' cap falls far below the fallback of 12 months' fees and below the six-month walk-away floor, and the trailing 'without exception' pulls the Section 21.3 Excluded Claims (indemnities, confidentiality, gross negligence, wilful misconduct) inside the cap with no super-cap — expressly walk-away territory.

Redline reaches the preferred position: mutual cap on the greater of twelve months' Fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, with an express carve-out for Excluded Claims, leveraging the existing Section 21.3 definition rather than restating it (smallest edit that works).

The high changed-character ratio is justified here — the original single sentence contains both defects (cap basis and 'without exception'), so replacing the sentence is the minimal way to correct it; no unrelated sections were rewritten.

Comment is accurate, correctly cites the playbook position, explains both changes, and correctly notes that Sections 21.2/21.3 already contemplate carve-outs; the unaddressed 'Fees' definition point (implementation charge excluded) is properly left as rationale-level commentary rather than an extra edit.
